scripts.build:slides: for f in modules/module_*.md; do grep -qE '^title:' "$f" && marp --html "$f" -o "modules/html/$(basename "$f" .md).html"; done
scripts.build:assignments: for f in assignments/*/*.md; do pandoc "$f" -o "${f%.md}.pdf" --pdf-engine=xelatex -V geometry:margin=1in; done
scripts.build: npm run build:slides && npm run build:notebooks && npm run build:site
